verdict.rationale: SerpApi's documented capability is restricted to scraping structured search engine results pages (Google, Bing, News, Ads, Flights, etc.); there is no evidence of any subpage/site-crawling capability that would follow a search result link to fetch and traverse the destination site's pages. All docs and GitHub references describe SERP scraping only, not general web crawling. Missing for 10: any documentation or code showing SerpApi fetching/crawling pages beyond the search results themselves, a crawl depth/breadth parameter, or site-wide crawling feature.
